standing.title: Smorgasburg Prospect Park
standing.address: Breeze Hill, Prospect Park (enter at Lincoln Road), Brooklyn, NY
standing.description: Brooklyn's open-air food market at Breeze Hill in Prospect Park, with dozens of independent vendors. Free to enter; pay per stall.
standing.time_note: Sundays 11am-6pm; arrive before noon to beat the line.
standing.practical_note: Entirely outdoors; check the forecast and bring water in heat.
standing.date_idea_reason: Open-air food market you can graze through together, then walk into Prospect Park.
standing.why_now: Runs every Sunday of the season and pairs naturally with a Prospect Park afternoon.

standing.title: NYC Resistor Public Craft Night
standing.description: Open craft night at the NYC Resistor hacker collective: bring a project, use the space, meet members. Free and open to the public, 18 and over.
standing.time_note: Mondays and Thursdays 6:30-9:30pm. Free, but 18+ only.
standing.practical_note: Fourth-floor walkup; confirm on Eventbrite since craft night is occasionally cancelled for private classes.
standing.date_idea_reason: A free, hands-on makerspace evening is an unusual low-cost date with something to actually do.
standing.why_now: Runs twice a week year-round and is one of the few genuinely free weeknight drop-in activities.

standing.title: Queens Night Market
standing.address: Behind the New York Hall of Science, 47-01 111th St, Flushing Meadows Corona Park, Queens, NY 11368
standing.description: Open-air night market behind the New York Hall of Science with about a hundred independent food, art, and merchandise vendors, deliberately kept low-priced.
standing.time_note: Saturdays 4pm to midnight. Note the seasonal gap between late August and mid September.
standing.practical_note: Outdoors and cash-friendly; the adjacent lot charges for parking, so the 7 train is easier.

price.display: Free entry; most dishes capped at a few dollars

standing.date_idea_reason: Cheap, walkable, and genuinely varied: dozens of cuisines in one loop, good for a low-pressure evening.
standing.why_now: Runs every Saturday evening in season; the 7 train to 111th St drops you four blocks away.

standing.title: Whitney Museum free Friday evening
standing.description: The Whitney is free to all every Friday evening from 5 to 10pm, and also on the second Sunday of each month.
standing.time_note: Free admission Fridays 5-10pm. Free tickets are limited and released in advance.
standing.practical_note: Reserve the free timed ticket ahead; walk-up availability runs out on busy evenings.
standing.date_idea_reason: Free evening museum hours next to the High Line and a dense stretch of bars, so the museum is the anchor rather than the whole plan.
standing.why_now: A standing free window that makes a good anchor for a Friday evening in the Meatpacking District.

standing.title: MoMA free Friday evening
standing.description: MoMA offers free admission on Friday evenings. Free tickets are limited, released in advance, and go quickly.
standing.time_note: Free Friday evenings, roughly 4-8pm. Confirm the current window and ticket release on moma.org.
standing.practical_note: Book the free timed ticket the moment it is released; the line for walk-ups is long.
standing.why_now: A standing weekly free window at a museum that is otherwise one of the most expensive in the city.

holiday_plan.intro: For Labor Day weekend, choose a car-free Hudson Valley day trip or an overnight within roughly a three-hour drive of NYC. Confirm holiday hours and book museum entry before committing to transport. Allow extra time for holiday traffic.

trips.title: Beacon art day: Dia Beacon plus Main Street
trips.why: A strong car-free art-and-food day: large-scale contemporary art at Dia Beacon, then cafes, galleries, and riverfront time in Beacon. Keep this as a flexible Saturday or Sunday pick because Dia’s Labor Day-specific hours were not confirmed from the official page during this check.
trips.transport: Metro-North Hudson Line from Grand Central to Beacon, then walk or local ride to Dia/Main Street; MTA schedules page should be checked for holiday service.
trips.time_budget: Full day; Dia’s official directions cite about 80 minutes by car from New York, while train timing must be checked on MTA for the chosen departure.
trips.booking_note: Confirm Dia Beacon’s 2026 Labor Day weekend hours and timed-entry/admission rules directly before going; the official Dia pages loaded but did not expose current hours in the fetched text.

trips.title: Cold Spring industrial-history walk and river village
trips.why: Very practical without a car: combine the walkable village with West Point Foundry Preserve, an outdoor industrial-history landscape that Scenic Hudson describes as an outdoor museum with trails, foundry remains, interpretive features, and ecological renewal.
trips.transport: Metro-North Hudson Line to Cold Spring; walk locally to the village, West Point Foundry Preserve, and Putnam History Museum if visiting on an open day.
trips.time_budget: Easy half-to-full day by train; the preserve itself is outdoors and suitable for a relaxed walking itinerary.
trips.booking_note: West Point Foundry Preserve is listed by Scenic Hudson as free and open year-round, dawn to dusk. Putnam History Museum is open Wednesday-Sunday 12PM-4PM in open season and closed Monday/Tuesday, so do not plan the museum for Labor Day Monday.

trips.title: Storm King sculpture landscape without driving
trips.why: The best big outdoor art option for the weekend: 500 acres of sculpture, walking, mountain views, and a built-in full-day rhythm. It is especially useful for Labor Day because both Storm King and Coach USA list Monday operation during the season.
trips.transport: Coach USA ShortLine round-trip package from Port Authority Bus Terminal includes bus transportation and Storm King admission; Storm King also lists train-plus-rideshare options via Beacon or Salisbury Mills-Cornwall, with admission not included for train routes.
trips.time_budget: Coach USA’s official itinerary lists a 10:30AM NYC departure, 11:40AM Storm King arrival, 4:00PM Storm King departure, and 5:15PM NYC arrival.
trips.booking_note: Storm King lists Wednesday-Monday opening, closed Tuesdays, 10AM-6PM with final entry 5PM; advance tickets are recommended. Coach USA package terms and exact date availability should be checked before purchase.

trips.title: Hudson and Olana art-landscape overnight
trips.destination: Hudson, NY and Olana State Historic Site
trips.why: A one-night escape with a good mix of Hudson restaurants/antiques and Olana’s 250-acre Frederic Church landscape, carriage roads, views, house tours, and visitor center. Best as Saturday-Sunday or Sunday-Monday if lodging and transport work.
trips.transport: Typically car-free by Amtrak Empire Service to Hudson, then taxi/rideshare or local transport to Olana; Amtrak official station/service pages were blocked during this check, so train schedules and holiday service remain unconfirmed.
trips.time_budget: One night is the right pace: arrive midday, do Hudson food/galleries, then Olana landscape or tour the next day before returning.
trips.booking_note: Olana’s official plan-your-visit metadata says the landscape is free and open daily from 8AM to sunset; confirm house-tour ticket times, visitor center hours, and Labor Day operations before booking lodging.

trips.title: Philadelphia art, food, and Independence history
trips.why: A higher-energy car-free overnight: Old City/Independence history, Reading Terminal-style food wandering, the Barnes Foundation, and walkable neighborhoods make it feel like a real break without needing a car.
trips.transport: Use Amtrak or NJ Transit/SEPTA combinations from New York; NJ Transit and SEPTA official schedule/trip-planner pages were checked, while Amtrak pages were blocked, so compare live schedules before committing.
trips.time_budget: One night; feasible as a Saturday-Sunday or Sunday-Monday trip if train availability and museum hours line up.
trips.booking_note: NPS Independence hours pages were checked but did not expose detailed current hours in fetched text; Visit Philly warns INHP sites may have limited hours and says to check the official NPS site. Barnes plan-your-visit page was checked; verify Labor Day hours and timed tickets.

local_ideas.title: Governors Island low-friction holiday day
local_ideas.why: Official Governors Island alert says the island is open 7AM-10PM on Labor Day, with Governors Island ferries on a Sunday schedule from Manhattan and Brooklyn and NYC Ferry on a weekend schedule; good for a no-planning-needed skyline, picnic, bike, and public-art day.

local_ideas.title: West Indian American Day Carnival in Brooklyn
local_ideas.why: The official WIADCA site confirms the organization and history of the West Indian American Day Carnival, making it the major distinctive NYC Labor Day cultural idea; the event-specific 2026 route/timing page was not found in this check, so verify street closures, parade hours, and safety/transit advisories before going.

local_ideas.title: US Open Labor Day weekend in Queens
local_ideas.why: A classic NYC long-weekend option if you want a festive sports crowd and Flushing food before or after. The official US Open schedule page timed out during this check, so exact sessions, grounds access, and ticket status remain unconfirmed.

local_ideas.title: NYBG Flower Power in the Bronx
local_ideas.why: NYBG’s official page currently highlights Flower Power, including 1960s- and 1970s-related art and photography alongside the garden’s 250-acre setting; use it as a less crowded in-city nature/art fallback if Hudson Valley plans are too tight.

checks: Confirm each venue’s Labor Day Monday hours; museums and historic houses often differ from outdoor grounds.
Check timed-entry or advance-ticket requirements for Dia Beacon, Storm King, Olana house tours, Barnes Foundation, and US Open before booking transport.
Check MTA, Coach USA, NJ Transit, SEPTA, and Amtrak live schedules for holiday/weekend service, last return, and service alerts.
For car-free trips that need a station transfer, confirm taxi/rideshare availability before arrival, especially Storm King train routes and Olana from Hudson.
Do not assume lodging or event-ticket availability; verify before making the trip plan final.
For Thanksgiving planning, remember that a four-day weekend requires taking Friday off unless the employer separately grants it.
